description.text: The ninth enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 2 September 2022, built around strong and beautiful Pokémon and made with sealed play in mind. Alolan Vulpix VSTAR was the first Pokémon VSTAR of an unevolved Pokémon: its VSTAR Power attack needs no Energy and does more damage the more Pokémon V the opponent has. Serperior VSTAR, Mawile VSTAR, Reshiram V, Ho-Oh V, Magearna V and Radiant Jirachi join it, with Serena, a Supporter that refreshes its player's hand or brings out one of the opponent's Pokémon V, and the Delphox line, whose attack grows with each Serena in the discard pile. Each pack held six cards, and some cards came in premium mirror versions that shine in the shape of a Poké Ball. The cards are numbered to 68, followed by six Character Rare Pokémon drawn with a Trainer, such as Braixen with Serena and Gardevoir with Diantha, full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, Character Super Rare Serperior V and Mawile V, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VSTAR and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Serperior VSTAR, Energy Switch and V Guard Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Silver Tempest in November 2022 and Crown Zenith in January 2023.
